questions.question: How many individuals moved from California to Texas according to the 2023 ACS estimates?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_to_state_migration_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='tool_input')
val = df[(df['Residence 1 Year Ago'] == 'California') & (df['Current Residence'] == 'Texas')]['Estimate'].values[0]
result = int(val)

questions.question: Which state had the greatest total number of people moving out to other states in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_to_state_migration_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='tool_input')
sub = df[['State', 'Out-Movers Estimate']].dropna().drop_duplicates()
sub['Out-Movers Estimate'] = pd.to_numeric(sub['Out-Movers Estimate'], errors='coerce')
result = sub.sort_values(by='Out-Movers Estimate', ascending=False).iloc[0]['State']

questions.question: In 2023, did Florida have more people move in from other states than California did?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_to_state_migration_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='tool_input')
sub = df[['State', 'In-Movers Estimate']].dropna().drop_duplicates()
fl_in = pd.to_numeric(sub[sub['State'] == 'Florida']['In-Movers Estimate'].values[0])
ca_in = pd.to_numeric(sub[sub['State'] == 'California']['In-Movers Estimate'].values[0])
result = 'yes' if fl_in > ca_in else 'no'

questions.question: How many states (including DC and Puerto Rico) experienced over 200,000 in-movers from other states in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_to_state_migration_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='tool_input')

questions.question: What is the net migration between Florida and New York in 2023 (calculated as people moving from New York to Florida minus people moving from Florida to New York)?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_to_state_migration_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='tool_input')
ny_to_fl = pd.to_numeric(df[(df['Residence 1 Year Ago'] == 'New York') & (df['Current Residence'] == 'Florida')]['Estimate'].values[0])
fl_to_ny = pd.to_numeric(df[(df['Residence 1 Year Ago'] == 'Florida') & (df['Current Residence'] == 'New York')]['Estimate'].values[0])
result = int(ny_to_fl - fl_to_ny)
